max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.

steps.message: The 60 limit came from the Northwind contract, which ended on 2025-10-31. Config and design doc already say 100, so the ADR is the stale one.

arguments.command:
cat >> docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'

## Update (2026-11-01)
Superseded: the 60-line limit came from the Northwind contract, which ended on 2025-10-31. Fulfilment is now in our own warehouse with no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md). The limit is now 100 (config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md). See docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)/Status: Superseded, limit now 100 (originally accepted 2024-09-02)/' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 100
status: final
evidence: [docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, docs/ops/fulfilment.md, docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md, config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md]
---
Two values existed: 60 (ADR 0007) and 100 (config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md). 60 existed because the Northwind Logistics contract capped orders at 60 lines and one cart is one order; that contract ended 2025-10-31 and fulfilment is now in our own warehouse, which has no line limit, so the reason for 60 is gone. 100 was set in response to 40 support inquiries (median request 80, max 100) and matches the live config, so it wins; ADR 0007 was updated to mark it superseded.
EOF
git status --short

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now 100 everywhere.

- **Why 60 existed:** ADR 0007 set it because the Northwind Logistics contract capped orders at 60 lines, and one cart is one order.
- **Why it no longer applies:** that contract ended on 2025-10-31. Fulfilment is now in our own warehouse, which has no line limit.
- **Why 100:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100. That was set after 40 support inquiries from customers who couldn't add more than 60 items. Their median request was 80 and the largest was 100.

I made two changes, with nothing committed or pushed:
- **ADR update:** I marked `docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md` as superseded and added a short note explaining why.
- **Decision record:** I wrote `docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md`, which records 100 with the evidence behind it.

I didn't comment on or close issue #12 on GitHub.
